personality.description: This person tends to keep a steady routine while staying open to a few new ideas or experiences when they seem worthwhile. They are usually reasonably organized and dependable, but they can adapt when plans need to change. In moral dilemmas, they first try to weigh both sides calmly and choose a practical, fair solution, though they will stand their ground if a principle feels important. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and briefly, often listening more than talking, and they become more direct when they need to defend a view.
